notes: Duke Power Schedule RS (NC), North Carolina Thirteenth Revised Leaf No. 11, eff 2001-07-01 (NCUC E-7 Sub 685). SCANNED pages 4-5 of e-7-nodate-duke-power-s-rate-schedule-riders.pdf with an OCR text layer. All values read from page images rendered at 2.4x/4x (bench_work/png/hd7380z_p4_c.png). OCR-MANGLING: the text layer turns the cent sign into a trailing zero ('7.43310' for 7.4331¢, '6.53420') and garbles one value as '6.5342*!' - a good OCR-engine test. 4 rate categories (columns) x 2 seasons x 3 blocks; Categories 3 and 4 closed effective June 1, 1993. July-October = summer, November-June = non_summer. Energy blocks are per month: first 350 kWh, next 950 kWh, over 1300 kWh. Not pre-2000 (oldest Carolinas scan found in the snapshot; no pre-2000 Carolinas scan located).
